questions.question: Round 148 365 to the nearest 10, 100 and 1 000.
questions.expected_answer: Nearest 10: the units digit 5 rounds up, giving 148 370. Nearest 100: the tens digit 6 rounds up, giving 148 400. Nearest 1 000: the hundreds digit 3 rounds down, giving 148 000.

questions.question: Work out 153 840 minus 148 365 and check your answer by adding.
questions.expected_answer: 153 840 minus 148 365 is 5 475. Check: 148 365 plus 5 475 is 153 840, which is the number we started with.

questions.question: 24 stalls each pay R135. Work out the total and check with an estimate.
questions.expected_answer: 20 times 135 is 2 700 and 4 times 135 is 540, so the total is R3 240. Estimate: 25 times 130 is 3 250, which is close, so the answer makes sense.
